# Mode

Switch the active behavioral context.

## What It Does
Loads `contexts/<mode>.md` and records the choice in session state. This mutates session
state rather than invoking a skill, which is why it has no skill file.

## Usage
```
/mode dev
/mode review
/mode research
```

## The Three Modes
| Mode | Posture | Edits? |
|------|---------|--------|
| `dev` | Working solution first, verify after every change. The default. | Yes |
| `review` | Pre-Report Gate, severity discipline, zero findings is valid. | No |
| `research` | Hypothesis then verification, everything confidence-tagged. | No |

## Notes
Each mode is short by design. A mode that takes 2,000 tokens to describe is not a mode,
it is a second skill.
